writing.task: Choose one of two supplied natural-wonder fact cards and write an informational entry for another Grade 7 class. Introduce the place and at least two useful features, explain the choice, and include a brief reasoned reply to a supplied reader question. An invented preference is allowed; no travel, purchasing, outside research or personal disclosure is needed.
